heads.t: 被金光收藏的名字──后里泰安羽粼落羽松記 2026/10/30 冬天若有名字，我想，它會在后里泰安被輕聲喚出。 那一天，我走進羽粼落羽松林，像翻開一本早已熟悉卻仍令人屏息的書頁，金黃、綠黃與咖啡紅，在枝梢間緩慢流動，彷彿季節正在低聲敘述自己的故事。 落羽松靜立水畔，不急不徐，任由色彩在身上層層疊加。它們不以濃烈取勝，而以深情動人。筆直的樹幹像時間的刻度，記錄著一年四季的更迭；輕柔的枝葉則像冬天的筆觸，在空氣中描繪溫度。當微風掠過，整片林子輕輕搖曳，彷彿在向來訪的旅人致意。…
heads.en: 2026/10/30 in the winter, I think it'll be called softly in the back. On that day I walked into the plume of the plume, as if I had opened a page known to you but still to rest, golden, green and red, moving slowly in the branches, as if the season were whispering its story. The plume is standing on the side of the water, without rushing, leaving the colours on the surface. They do not win with strength, but they move in love. A straight trunk is a time scale that records the change of the season of the year; a soft branch is like a winter touch that depicts temperature in the air. And when the breeze passed, the whole forest swayed as if it were greeting those who came to visit. I don't know.

heads.en: You can't lose weight on thin needles! Top5 shows up. Some have lost weight on 168 diets, others have been retrained and run every day, and others have lost more than a dozen kilograms on super-red thin needles! But it's really not the faster we lose weight, the better it gets. It's also about whether we're going to get fat, whether we're going to last long and whether we're going to be burdened. heads.t: 獨／控奇美醫院太汙辱！僅保障首年5萬薪 醫師被挖角純靠提成 台南一名眼科醫師王志盟公開控訴，柳營奇美醫院主動挖角卻開出極低薪資條件，首年僅保障5萬元月薪，第二年起更完全取消保障，純粹依靠看診與治療提成計算收入，雙方最終因條件談不攏而破局。對此，醫師公會則持不同立場，認為不宜設定最低薪資門檻，否則恐將衝擊醫療體系運作，甚至影響病患權益。 16 分鐘前｜生活 獨／控奇美醫院太汙辱！僅保障首年5萬薪 醫師被挖角純靠提成 16 分鐘前｜生活
heads.en: Unique/controlled Chimi Hospital is a disgrace! It's only guaranteed 50,000 for the first year. The doctors are being exploited as a mere public prosecution by an ophthalmologist in Tainan, and the Chimi Hospital's main outburst is offering a very low salary rate, with 50,000 yuan a month in the first year, with more complete cuts in the second year, purely based on medical and therapeutic calculations, with both parties finally breaking the board because of the deal. In this case, the Medical Society has taken a different position, arguing that it would not be appropriate to set a minimum wage or threaten to disrupt the functioning of the medical system, or even affect the rights of patients. Sixteen minutes ago, the isolation/control hospital was a disgrace!

heads.t: 3飆股明起「抓去關」！處置期一次看 這檔6天漲逾41％也入列 台股新增3檔處置股！證交所及櫃買中心今（29）日公告，將東台（4526）、冠西電（2466）與達航科技（4577）列入處置名單，3檔個股皆處每2分鐘撮合一次；值得注意的是，東台的處置期是從明（30）日起至11月9日止，其餘2檔則是明天起到11月5日為止。 17 分鐘前｜財經 3飆股明起「抓去關」！處置期一次看 這檔6天漲逾41％也入列 17 分鐘前｜財經

heads.t: 影音／國籍航空飛仁川班機「燈號異常」！延誤逾4小時 連帶影響8航班 桃園機場航班延誤！華航一架飛往韓國仁川的班機，今天（29日）上午原定7點50分起飛，沒想到因機務訊號異常，飛機滑行後被要求返回停機坪檢查，旅客在機上等候約兩個小時，行程大受影響，後續更連帶造成8個航班延誤。航空公司緊急調派另一架班機接替，直到中午12點半左右才順利起飛，整體延誤超過4個小時。華航表示，為確保飛航安全，必須依照程序完成檢查，對造成旅客不便表達歉意。 23 分鐘前｜社會 影音／國籍航空飛仁川班機「燈號異常」！延誤逾4小時 連帶影響8航班 23 分鐘前｜社會
heads.en: Video/National Airlines Flight Incheon, "Lighted Unusual"! A flight to Incheon, Korea, scheduled to take off at 7.50 a.m. today (29 a.m.) was asked to return to the apron after a flight had slipped because of an unusual air traffic signal, and passengers were waiting on the plane for about two hours, which had a significant impact on the flight, causing eight delays in subsequent series. The airline urgently deployed another flight to replace it, which did not take off until about 12:30, and the entire flight lasted more than four hours. In order to ensure the safety of the flight, the inspection must be completed in accordance with the procedure, which apologizes for the inconvenience caused to the passengers. Twenty-three minutes ago, the film/national airline flight Incheon "Lights Unusual" was delayed by more than four hours.

heads.t: 韓美妝店「強迫推銷2萬元」 小澈老師：遭多名壯漢包圍施壓 一名台灣旅客日前赴韓國明洞美妝店購物，卻遭五名店員包圍瘋狂推銷，甚至假借送贈品強迫購買兩萬元商品，當旅客要求退款時，店家竟派出多名壯漢施壓，並試圖將旅客帶往小房間，最終旅客仍被迫購買三千多元不需要的商品，事後向韓國觀光公社申訴卻因商品已拆封而難以成功。 24 分鐘前｜生活 韓美妝店「強迫推銷2萬元」 小澈老師：遭多名壯漢包圍施壓 24 分鐘前｜生活
heads.en: The Korean-American make-up store "fortified 20,000 dollars" Miss Cheong: under pressure from a strong man in Taiwan Passengers who went to Korea's Mingkook Make-up store to buy goods are being sold wildly by five shopkeepers and even forced to buy $20,000 on the basis of gifts. After pressure from Han and attempts to take passengers to small rooms, passengers were forced to buy more than 3,000 items that they did not need, and later petitioned the Korean Tourist Society to succeed because the goods were closed down. 24 minutes ago, the Korean-American make-up store forced the sale of $20,000.

heads.t: 分隊長下值班騎車赴大隊開會遇車禍重創！消防人員急救後查身分驚見是自己人 台中市消防局東英消防分隊長黃昶維於10月29日上午騎車前往大隊開會途中，在東區東光路與自由路口和左轉車發生擦撞，頭臉嚴重受創、一度失去呼吸心跳。救護人員到場先搶救，再查看傷者身分，驚覺傷者竟是自家分隊長，強忍悲傷持續急救。黃昶維送醫後雖恢復呼吸心跳，但因腦部水腫嚴重，先置放腦壓偵測器，尚未脫離險境。 12 分鐘前｜社會 分隊長下值班騎車赴大隊開會遇車禍重創！消防人員急救後查身分驚見是自己人 12 分鐘前｜社會
heads.en: The team leader was on duty on a bus to a party meeting. Firefighters were in shock after an emergency check of their own. On the morning of October 29th, the East Central Fire Department’s East British Fire Department Chief Wong Zhui was riding to a party meeting, and there was a collision between East Light Road and the Liberty Pass and a left-turner, with severe head injury and a loss of breathing heart. The ambulance personnel arrived to rescue and then check the identity of the wounded, who were the head of their own unit and who endured constant first aid. Although he recovered his breathing heart after he was brought to the hospital, he was not out of danger because of his severe brain swelling and his brain pressure detector. 12 minutes ago, the team leader was on a bus to a party meeting. Firefighter's emergency clearance surprised us.

heads.t: 韓版《鐵拳教育》真實上演！恐龍家長闖教室辱師 江原道教育監出手告發 韓劇《鐵拳教育》真實版，竟然在南韓上演！南韓江原道一名家長涉嫌長期干涉教師教學，不僅在網路上公開導師姓名，還多次發文辱罵、恐嚇，甚至在上課時間闖進教室，當著學生的面辱罵老師。受害教師獨自隱忍長達5個月，身心飽受煎熬。江原道教育監姜三榮決定以本人名義向警方提出刑事告發，盼能遏止惡意侵害教權的行為。 23 分鐘前｜國際 韓版《鐵拳教育》真實上演！恐龍家長闖教室辱師 江原道教育監出手告發 23 分鐘前｜國際
heads.en: The Korean version of Iron Fist Education is real! In South Korea, a head of the family, suspected of long-term interference with the teaching of teachers, not only by making the names of their mentors publicly available online, but also by making numerous insults and threats, even breaking into the classroom at school hours and insulting teachers in front of their students. The victim teachers have been alone for five months, suffering from physical and psychological suffering. Jiangwon Education Supervisor Kang San-hoon has decided to file a criminal complaint in his own name with the police in the hope of deterring any attempt to violate the right to education. Twenty-three minutes ago, the Korean version of Iron Fist Education actually took place! The head of the dinosaurs broke into the classroom to humiliate the teacher, and Jiangwon-do-Pedagogical reported 23 minutes ago.

heads.t: 獨家／公車滿地血⋯一路流到駕駛座！司機嚇壞急停 竟是64歲乘客腿受傷渾然不知 台中一輛公車驚見大片血跡！28日傍晚，一輛23路公車行經五權南路時，駕駛發現地板上有液體，一開始還以為是水，仔細一看竟然是鮮血，從座位一路延伸到駕駛座附近，嚇得他趕緊靠邊停車。原來，一名64歲男乘客疑似上車時不慎撞傷右小腿，造成撕裂傷、持續出血，但因為腿部沒有知覺，竟然一路都沒發現自己受傷。所幸駕駛及時察覺，還有熱心女學生協助通報，男子隨後送醫治療。 24 分鐘前｜社會 獨家／公車滿地血⋯一路流到駕駛座！司機嚇壞急停 竟是64歲乘客腿受傷渾然不知 24 分鐘前｜社會
heads.en: An exclusive bus was bleeding all the way to the driver's seat! The driver was in a state of panic, and a 64-year-old passenger was hurt in the leg. In the evening of 28, as a 23rd bus was travelling through South Avenue, the driver found liquid on the floor, initially thought it was water, and looked at the blood from the seat all the way to the driver ' s seat, scaring him to pull over. Originally, a 64-year-old male passenger suspected to have accidentally hit his right calf, causing tear wounds and sustained bleeding, but did not find himself injured all the way to his leg because he was unconscious. He was lucky enough to drive and be aware of it, and he was assisted by a passionate female student who sent him to medical treatment. Twenty-four minutes ago, an exclusive bus was bleeding all the way to the driver's seat! The driver's in shock, and the 64-year-old passenger's leg is completely unknown.

heads.t: 影音／划船800公里闖剛果！威爾斯探險家遇殺人蜂、暴風雨 失聯近24小時驚險脫困 威爾斯35歲探險家戴克斯（Ash Dykes），日前帶領攝影師及當地導遊，划著充氣式獨木舟深入非洲剛果盆地，展開極限冒險。團隊耗時18天，沿著桑加河划行約800公里，途中不只近距離遇見銀背大猩猩，還遭到殺人蜂追趕、猛烈暴風雨襲擊，甚至因通訊設備斷電，一度與外界失聯近24小時。所幸三人最終平安抵達終點，成功完成這趟驚險旅程。 25 分鐘前｜國際 影音／划船800公里闖剛果！威爾斯探險家遇殺人蜂、暴風雨 失聯近24小時驚險脫困 25 分鐘前｜國際
heads.en: Video/boat rowing 800 kilometers into Congo! Wells explorers were killed by bees, storm, almost 24 hours in distress. Canoes go deep into the Congo Basin in Africa, opening up extreme risks. The team spent 18 days travelling about 800 kilometres along the Sanga River, not only meeting silverback gorillas at close range, but also being chased by killer bees, hit by heavy storms, and, at one point, lost contact with the outside world for nearly 24 hours due to power cuts from communications facilities. Fortunately, the three were able to reach their final destination and successfully complete this adventure. 25 minutes ago, the international film/boat broke 800 kilometers into Congo!
